title: B1: when may a session adopt a change another session wrote?
context: Path found: on 2026-10-28T17:21:40Z the SessionStart hook runtime/hooks/agent-entry-session-start.mjs called reconcileSessionControl for the new session 5067f880. The checkout was on feat/parallel-review-docs-753, the 753 bundle was the only in-flight bundle on that branch, and session c08524c9 had development, checks and documentation_sync started and not ended in it. The FR-3 rule (adopt the single in-flight bundle on the branch for a session that never saw it) adopted it. The Stop-hook readers (marker-parse, hook-cost, completion-deferred, narration, receipt-file) call the same reconcile on every turn. Conflict: the suggested simple rule (never adopt a bundle with rows only from other sessions) breaks contracted tests FR-3, FR-6, AC-1 and AC-4 in tests/unit/feature-evidence/adoption.test.ts, which keep one change when the session id rotates (the CLI without SE_SESSION reads the shared ledger-session cache, which another session can overwrite) or after /clear. With the simple rule, resolveActiveFeature would mint a second bundle on the same branch and split the change. No reliable per-session liveness signal exists (HUD heartbeat is Claude Code only and stays fresh 120 s after /clear; host_pid is only on stage-agent rows).

options.label: Refuse adoption only while another session runs a stage there: a session with no row in the bundle does not adopt it while a stage_start from another session has no stage_end or a stage agent from another session is live (reuse hasOpenUnendedStage and liveStageAgents). Passive readers return null; a bare stage start on that branch stops with a message naming the running change and pointing at --title instead of minting a second bundle. Quiet bundles are still adopted (FR-3, FR-6 and /clear between stages keep working); the AC-1 and AC-4 fixtures change to rotate after the stage ends.

options.label: Never adopt a bundle that has rows only from other sessions (the simple rule). Retire FR-3, FR-6, AC-1 and AC-4 adoption; a rotated or cleared session continues a change only with stage start --title of a new change, so one change can split into two bundles.
